removed: Removed "{name}". Extensions installed from it stay.
markets_footer: A market is an index of extensions (persona-extensions.json) published by a website or a git / GitHub repository. For a private https / GitHub market, add a read-only token: it's stored encrypted on the hub, sent only to that market and never shown again. git: markets use the hub machine's own SSH credentials. Removing a market doesn't affect extensions installed from it.
no_markets_detail: Add an https address, {github} or {git}. Once the hub reads its index, you can browse and install its extensions here.
catalog_footer: Installing an extension runs a new program on the hub machine. Install shows what it can do first and installs only once you agree; packages are checked against the market's sha256. Upgrade, roll back or uninstall market extensions in the list above.
manage_above: Installed from this market; manage it in the list above.
previewing: Downloading and checking what it can do
token_git_placeholder: git: markets don't use a token
token_git_hint: git: markets are read with the hub machine's own SSH credentials and take no token.
token_hint: For GitHub, use a read-only fine-grained token (Contents read access to this repository). It's stored encrypted on the hub and never shown again.
adding: Reading its index once; it's added only if that works…
new_token: New token (the current one isn't shown)
token_save_hint: After saving, the hub reads the index again with it.
official_unreachable: Can't reach the official extensions right now. Try again later.
catalog_unreadable: Can't read the marketplace right now. Its extensions show up here once it can be read
